roles_as_listed: Vice President and Chief Information Officer
company_context: Creator of a universal airline miles loyalty rewards program that let members earn miles through partners including Kroger, Avis Car Rental, Wyndham Hotels, the WebMiles Credit Card, and online retailers. Received $40 million in venture capital funding.
